klse.task: klse build-dir & klse compile-folder c++ dist/obj/klse src/KLSE '-I./includes' & klse merge-lib dist/libs/klse.lib dist/obj/klse

gl.task: klse compile-folder c++ dist/obj/klse_gl src/KLSE/GL '-I./includes' & klse merge-lib dist/libs/klse_gl.lib dist/obj/klse_gl

glfw.task: klse compile-folder c++ dist/obj/klse_glfw src/KLSE/GLFW '-I./includes' & klse merge-lib dist/libs/klse_glfw.lib dist/obj/klse_glfw

full.task: klse task build klse & klse task build klse gl & klse task build klse glfw

window.task: klse task build klse full & g++ src/tests/window.cpp -L./dist/libs -I./includes -lklse_gl -lklse_glfw -lklse -lglfw3 -lgdi32 -lopengl32 -ldwmapi -o dist/bin/tests/window.exe

objects2d.task: klse task build klse full & g++ src/tests/objects2d.cpp -L./dist/libs -I./includes -lklse_gl -lklse_glfw -lklse -lglfw3 -lgdi32 -lopengl32 -ldwmapi -o dist/bin/tests/objects.exe
